title: TaskFlow release pair v1.0
description: Structural release-pair contract, not scan approval or proof of registry provenance. No actual release instance is committed.
$comment: validate_release_pair.py additionally enforces equal registry/region/name prefix and calendar validity. Git tag is derived from lowercase git_commit. Digest hex is normalized only in derived references. See docs/REGISTRY_DELIVERY.md.

git_commit.description: One reviewed full Git SHA shared by both artifacts.

frontend_repository.description: ECR repository URI without scheme, tag or digest.

frontend_digest.description: Registry manifest digest for the frontend, never a local image/config ID.

backend_repository.description: ECR repository URI; same registry/region/prefix as frontend.

backend_digest.description: Registry manifest digest for the backend, never a local image/config ID.

digest_source.description: Producer assertion for BOTH digests; syntax cannot prove this provenance.

semantic_version.description: Optional shared immutable v-prefixed SemVer alias with optional prerelease; build metadata (+) is excluded because Docker tags cannot contain +.

build_timestamp.description: UTC pair build-start time, whole seconds; validator also checks calendar validity.

platform.description: One platform shared by both components.
